envelope.description: Build the dedicated review-worker runtime and bootstrap supervision

body.title: Build the dedicated review-worker runtime and bootstrap supervision
body.summary: Add proposed src/daemon/threads/review-worker.ts using existing startWorker/startDaemonWorker, hub channels, maintenance/store guards and status infrastructure. Each instance hosts exactly one existing code or design family coordinator. Extend parent startup supervision for the approved ready-plus-durable-save bound; this is not a task/model deadline.
acceptanceChecks: Worker startup works from source and compiled out paths and joins existing daemon model/tool/store/lock configuration.
The worker is dedicated to one canonical review identity and rejects other identities/families or stale incarnation messages.
Parent-owned 30-second bootstrap deadline starts before creation and ends after readiness plus durable admission-save acknowledgment; late messages cannot revive a closing instance.
Never-ready and pre-save-hung workers return named failures promptly; resource/lock/store cleanup proceeds with a targeted fence rather than blocking the request indefinitely.
Failure cannot silently fall back to a main/session worker or introduce an activation flag.

tests.name: src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-bootstrap.test.ts: real worker joins guards and starts from the registered entrypoint
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-worker-bootstrap.test.ts: never-ready and pre-save-hung workers fail within the parent bound and reject late acknowledgments
